title: Income Annuities Arrears Installment Settlement: Taxable Part, Withholding, Interest and Amount Sent
content:
An arrears installment on an Ashgrove Income Annuities period-certain contract is settled as one payment whose amount sent is defined as follows.

## Settlement clause

1. **Gross installment.** The arrears installment is paid at the current installment on the contract.
2. **Tax-free part.** The tax-free part is the installment multiplied by the exclusion ratio on the contract, rounded to the cent, but never more than the purchase amount less the tax-free amount already recovered, and never less than zero. The tax-free amount already recovered is the purchase amount less the unreturned purchase amount on the contract, multiplied by the exclusion ratio, rounded to the cent.
3. **Taxable part.** The taxable part is the installment less the tax-free part.
4. **Federal tax.** Federal tax is withheld from the taxable part at the rate on the contract's withholding election, rounded to the cent.
5. **State tax.** No state tax is withheld.
6. **Interest.** Interest is added at the tier's death-claim interest rate, simple, for the actual days from the date due proof of death was received (the received date of the death claim on file whose certified death certificate is shown as received) to the payment date, over 365, rounded to the cent.
7. **Amount sent.** The amount sent is the arrears installment plus the interest, less the federal tax and the state tax. The federal tax, the state tax and the interest are each rounded to the cent on their own before the amount sent is worked out.

## Worked figure (hypothetical contract)

| Input (hypothetical) | Value |
|---|---|
| Current installment on the contract | $1,500.00 |
| Exclusion ratio | 40% |
| Purchase amount | $300,000.00 |
| Unreturned purchase amount | $210,000.00 |
| Rate on the contract's withholding election | 10% |
| Death-claim interest rate of the tier, taken as | 3.5% |
| Days from receipt of due proof to the payment date | 50 |

- Tax-free amount already recovered: $300,000.00 less $210,000.00 is $90,000.00, multiplied by 40% is $36,000.00. Room left: $300,000.00 less $36,000.00, that is $264,000.00.
- Tax-free part: $1,500.00 multiplied by 40% is $600.00, within the room left.
- Taxable part: $900.00. Federal tax: $90.00. State tax: none.
- Interest: $1,500.00 multiplied by 3.5%, multiplied by 50, divided by 365 is $7.1918, so $7.19.
- Amount sent: $1,500.00 plus $7.19, less $90.00, is **$1,417.19**.

## Points of reading

- The base of the interest is the gross arrears installment.
- The base of the federal tax is the taxable part.
- Each of the three amounts is rounded before they are combined, so the amount sent is a sum of cent figures.
